tony-gibson.name: Tony Gibson
tony-gibson.bio: Tony Gibson was a British programmer, artist and musician associated with Taskset and other early C64 development. His CCG music credits include Jammin' and Seaside Special, while his wider game work made him a recognised figure in the early UK home-computer industry.

sources.title: Games That Weren't Tony Gibson remembrance

tony-williams.name: Tony Williams
tony-williams.bio: Tony Williams is an English composer, sound designer and sound programmer who entered the games industry in the 1980s. He co-founded Sound Images with Paul Tonge in 1989 and worked across C64, Amiga and console projects; his CCG credits include Psycho Hopper, Shinobi and Star Wars Droids.

wally-beben.name: Wally Beben
wally-beben.bio: Wally Beben is an English former game musician best known for a large body of Commodore 64 and Amiga music. Among his best-known pieces is the extended C64 soundtrack for Tetris, and his career also included original music, arrangements and sound effects across numerous home-computer releases.
